557:t_018:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm getting past you, $$レナード$$! I have to reach $$千鳥$$!!」

557:t_019:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I can't understand what you're thinking.」

557:t_019:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「You mean why we're getting in the way of your plan!?」

557:t_019:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You expect us to accept something that'll kill people all over the world!?」

557:t_019:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Enough with the pretense. Tell me what you really feel.」

557:t_019:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「You really hate it, don't you? Curse it, don't you? Your own fate... this world itself.」

557:t_019:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I've had you all investigated, you see.」

557:t_019:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those who have lost loved ones and regret their past...」

557:t_019:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those who despair of what's to come and fear the future...」

557:t_019:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those filled with anxiety who want to escape the present...」

557:t_019:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you joined me, I could free you from all of that.」

557:t_019:20.en:
$n
「...Fitting for someone piloting $$ベリアル$$. Those are a devil's whispers.」

557:t_019:22.en:
$$レナード$$
「I wasn't asking you, $$テレサ$$. I'm speaking to each person's heart.」

557:t_019:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Fine. But even if you don't join me, at least letting $$時空修復$$ proceed has its benefits.」

557:t_019:27.en:
$$レナード$$
「Mental contamination by Iota waves... That will effectively destroy the $$新地球皇国$$, too.」

557:t_019:29.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course, the Empire's $$リアクター$$s will survive.」

557:t_019:30.en:
$$レナード$$
「The same goes for you. People with strong minds won't be swallowed up by the Iota waves.」

557:t_019:31.en:
$$レナード$$
「But ordinary citizens and the Empire's small fry will be finished.」

557:t_019:32.en:
$$レナード$$
「That will reverse the difference in our numbers. Then you can gather the strong survivors and retake Earth.」

557:t_019:33.en:
$$万丈$$
「Your logic sounds as though you think it's fine as long as only the strong survive.」

557:t_019:34.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's exactly what I meant. No one else could possibly face the future of despair that's coming.」

557:t_019:35.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So you know those words, too...!」

557:t_020:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! And $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, too!」

557:t_020:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What the hell are you here for!?」

557:t_020:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I came to watch mere Wingless use the power of a god.」

557:t_020:6.en:
$$ズール$$
「To try to use that power without ascending to godhood...」

557:t_020:7.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Earthlings truly are a warped species.」

557:t_020:8.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「All must be guided by $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

557:t_021:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Evil gods. You underestimate the power of Earthlings.」

557:t_021:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's been a while, $n. Your growth is a joy to see.」

557:t_021:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What do you want, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

557:t_021:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「You here to watch too, just like those villains' bosses!?」

557:t_021:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「My purpose differs slightly from theirs. I came to encourage him in his attempt to use a god's power.」

557:t_021:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Give it your all. Your resistance to the future of despair is even beautiful.」

557:t_021:8.en:
$$ズール$$
「If you turn your eyes away from the truth, so be it.」

557:t_021:9.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「We will take this planet after your $$時空修復$$ is complete.」

557:t_021:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Until then, kill each other. You incomplete species that will never attain godhood.」

557:t_022:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「They just said whatever the hell they wanted and left!」

557:t_022:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have been your ally until now... and I will remain so.」

557:t_022:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be waiting. For the day you fight alongside me.」

557:t_023:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「They probably came out of pure curiosity to see me, someone who chose a different path from them.」

557:t_023:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Who knows...? I'll leave them to you.」

557:t_023:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Once our $$時空修復$$ is done, kill each other all you like in the world that follows.」

557:t_023:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't think we'll allow a world like that!」

557:t_024:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Ghh...! My $$ベリアル$$ lost...!」

557:t_024:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Don't decide you've won, $$相良$$!」

557:t_025:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ベリアル$$ didn't lose to you. It lost to $c!」

557:t_025:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「And losing my AS doesn't mean I'm finished!」

557:t_025:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Knowing you, I thought you wouldn't admit defeat unless I, the one you look down on, finished you off completely.」

557:t_025:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「It seems you understand me a little.」

557:t_025:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's something else I know about you.」

557:t_025:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$テッサ$$ told me. She knows what your mother did.」
